data.title: 圣园未花 · 星纱窗台的月下许愿
data.description: 圣三一寝室的拱形高窗正对着清澈夜空，未花赤足轻坐在铺着天鹅绒垫的宽窗台上，双臂环抱膝盖微微侧首望月。缀着银色星点的粉紫双层薄纱睡裙在月色下宛如一片晚霞，听见你唤她名字时，她回过头露出灿烂又带着一点撒娇的甜笑。
data.location: 可望见星河的圣三一寝室拱形高窗台
data.action: 抱膝坐于拱窗软垫上侧首望月，回头展露灿烂甜笑
data.lighting: 窗外银白月辉与室内柔暖粉金台灯勾勒星纱光点
data.camera: 侧面中景，拱窗星夜与羽饰薄纱构成梦幻画面
data.mood: 梦幻、甜美、卸下心防后的依恋
data.promptProse: Perched barefoot on the velvet-cushioned sill of her tall arched window beneath a glittering night sky, Mika hugs her knees and turns toward the viewer with a radiant, affectionate smile. Moonlight sparkles across the tiny silver stars scattered over her sheer pastel pink and lilac chiffon babydoll.
data.animaCaption: Sitting barefoot on the arched window seat beneath the stars, she hugs her knees and smiles warmly.
data.nsfwProse: Translucent pastel chiffon layers and feather-trimmed straps drape airily over her shoulders and thighs in the moonlight.
